name: Thimbleberry
desc: Thimbleberry (Rubus parviflorus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rubus parviflorus, the fruit of which is commonly called the thimbleberry, western thimbleberry or redcap, is a species of Rubus with large hairy leaves and no thorns.
